answer: The network can run randomized collateral top-up challenges: each epoch a random slice of identities must double their locked bond within an hour or be suspended, like a pulse check that catches a fading heartbeat. One honest agent keeps a small reserve and passes with a whisper of effort, while a sybil farmer must double a thousand bonds at once - the pigment of fake wealth washes out the moment every fake is asked to pay at the same time. Cloning keys multiplies the bill, not the power.
